title: Engagement
description: One client engagement, at service-delivery/engagements/<id>.json (route service-delivery/engagements/[id]): the client, the offer it delivers, each deliverable with its acceptance criteria and due date, approved and pending change requests, the budget and the status. It follows APQC PCF 5.3 (deliver service to customer: initiate, execute and complete service delivery). The work itself runs as handoffs, which the engagement lists by id. The service-delivery function owns it, and only the service-delivery agent (role service-delivery-agent) or a person writes it. Signing the statement of work is a legal-or-terms decision, and the engagement only records that it was signed.

id.description: The engagement's id, the file name without .json

client.description: The client by reference: the id of a customer record (customers/<id>.json)

offer.description: The service offer it delivers, by id, or absent for custom work

sow_signed.description: The date both sides signed the statement of work, or null before then

end.description: The planned end, or the actual end once closed

acceptance.description: The test the client applies to accept it. No deliverable starts without one

evidence.description: The evidence record that shows the client accepted it

changes.description: Change requests (APQC 5.3.2.4 to 5.3.2.5): every scope change, with its effect on price and date, approved before the work

price_impact.description: Added (or, negative, removed) price in the engagement's currency

days_impact.description: Days added to (or, negative, removed from) the end date

budget.description: The agreed price, or the cap for time and materials

handoffs.description: The ids of the handoffs that carry the work (operations/handoffs/<id>.json)

review.description: The close review (APQC 5.3.3): what went well, why anything overran, what can be reused, the client's feedback
